sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

items.prompt: A bag has 2 red and 3 blue marbles. What is the theoretical probability of drawing red?

steps: Identify the favorable outcomes and the total possible outcomes.
Write the probability as a reduced fraction, or use it to predict or evaluate a count.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A fair coin is flipped and a spinner with 6 equal sections numbered 1 to 6 is spun. What is the probability of getting tails on the coin and landing on 2 on the spinner?
A pizza is made by choosing one topping from 4 options and one crust from 5 options. How many different pizzas are possible?

A probability model predicts a fair 5-section spinner lands on a chosen section about 18 times in 90 spins. A simulation of 90 spins landed on that section 19 times. How does the simulated count compare to the model's prediction?
An event has a probability of 1. How would you describe how likely the event is to happen?
A spinner was spun 30 times and landed on blue 13 times. Based on this experiment, what is the experimental probability of landing on blue?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: A bag has 2 red, 3 blue, and 6 green marbles. If one marble is drawn at random, what is the theoretical probability of drawing red, P(red)?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A fair coin is flipped and a spinner with 3 equal sections numbered 1 to 3 is spun. What is the probability of getting heads on the coin and landing on 1 on the spinner?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A meal is made by choosing one main dish from 4 options and one side dish from 2 options. How many different meals are possible?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
